title: There are levels to this walk. Which level are you on? 📈🧠
paragraphs: There are levels to this walk. Which level are you on? 📈🧠
"Weak people take revenge. Strong people forgive. Intelligent people ignore."
Revenge is emotional weakness; it means you let the enemy control your actions. Forgiveness is spiritual strength; it frees you from the burden of the past. But "ignoring"? That is spiritual wisdom.
Not every dog that barks deserves a response. Not every argument invites an answer. A warrior knows that distraction is just as dangerous as destruction. Save your ammo for the real battle.
📖 "A person’s wisdom yields patience; it is to one’s glory to overlook an offense." — Proverbs 19:11
Drop a 🧠 if you are choosing wisdom today. ⚔️ Follow @iamGospelWarrior to level up your mindset.
